  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:

          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"

          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"

        - type: object
          properties:

              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true

              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: Franklin, George
              readOnly: true

              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: G.F.
              readOnly: true

              title: Customer code

              type: string
              example: SMI-0007
              readOnly: true

              description: The owner's membership number formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>', where YY is the last two digits of the registrationDate year.
              type: string
              example: SMI-0007-M26
              readOnly: true

              title: Household ID
              description: Stable identifier shared by owners of the same household (same last name and address) that opted in via sharesHousehold.

              example: 3F2A1B0C
              readOnly: true

              title: Namesake count
              description: Number of existing owners that shared this owner's firstName and lastName (case-insensitively) at the moment it was created.

              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true

              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 3
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: Canonical region derived from the city (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD), or UNKNOWN when the city is not in the table.
              type: string
              example: NSW
              readOnly: true

              title: Contact preference
              description: EMAIL when an email is present, otherwise PHONE.

              example: EMAIL
              readOnly: true

              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:

              readOnly: true
          required:

## What I implemented

Optional `postcode` (4 digits) on owners: validated against the city's region only when present, otherwise accepted; stored and returned.

- **NSW/VIC/QLD ranges** enforced (Sydney 2000–2099, Melbourne 3000–3099, Brisbane 4000–4099); unknown-region cities accept any 4-digit code.
- **Malformed** postcodes (e.g. `"12"`) → 400.
- **Absent** postcode → still accepted (contract stays backward-compatible).

## Files touched (5) and why each is minimal

1. **`openapi.yml`** — added `postcode` to `OwnerFields` with `pattern: ^[0-9]{4}$`. The generated DTO gets the field (auto-mapped by MapStruct on both `Owner`↔`OwnerDto` directions, so store+return come for free) and a `@Pattern` that rejects malformed input as 400 with no code.
2. **`Owner.java`** — one field + a trivial getter/setter pair (each CC 1). No existing method changed.
3. **`db/hsqldb/schema.sql`** — one `postcode VARCHAR(4)` column (the test profile runs `ddl-auto=none`, so the column must be declared).
4. **`db/hsqldb/data.sql`** — appended a `NULL` to the 10 positional seed inserts to keep column counts matching.
5. **`OwnerFieldsValidator.java`** — the region-range rule lives in a **new small private method** `validatePostcode`; the existing `validate` method gains a single call line, so its own complexity and body are untouched. This class's surrounding complexity (`WMC_other`) is just the trivial `supports()`, so the new logic sits where it costs the least.

## Structural-impact notes
- No large or complex method was grown. The only edits to existing functions are one-line additions (the validator call) and new low-CC units (accessors, the postcode helper).
- The region table is inlined as a small `switch` in the new helper — same shape already used in `OwnerMapper` for `locality` — avoiding a new shared class and keeping the file count from growing further.
